preToolUse.comment: revgate: intercept exit_plan_mode and review the proposed plan before Copilot implements it. Approve -> the plan proceeds; request changes -> the agent revises. Other tools pass straight through. Timeout fails open.

agentStop.comment: revgate: open a GitHub-style review of the turn's changes and feed your review back to Copilot. Raise timeoutSec to however long you might spend reviewing.
